proof_scope: debugger baseline: the documented aggregate gate runs end-to-end, a live bdb breakpoint capture on a fresh target yields a valid proof, and the ladder validator rejects an out-of-order ladder receipt

claims.proves: the debugger's live breakpoint-capture path produces a debugger.proof.v1 the proof validator accepts, and the ladder validator bites on an invalid receipt rather than passing prose
claims.does_not_prove: VS Code bridge session control, Remote SSH authority, or human-agent collaboration -- those require live VS Code EDH / Remote SSH / human capabilities and are covered by the capability-gated matrix (#1441)

cases.name: sanity-gate-end-to-end
cases.description: The documented aggregate gate runs from a clean state: live bdb breakpoint capture, proof validation, the unreachable-breakpoint negative control, the file-not-mutated safety boundary, and the ladder gate. Proves no SKILL.md/sanity reference points at a missing file.

cases.name: live-bdb-breakpoint-capture
cases.description: Real live path with no stub inputs: create a fresh target outside the fixture tree, launch it under the bdb-based capturer, stop at a real breakpoint, capture a local, and validate the emitted proof independently.
command:
set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; T="$D/rw_target.py"; P="$D/rw_proof.json"; printf 'def classify(n):
    label = "big" if n > 10 else "small"
    return label

assert classify(14) == "big"
' > "$T"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$T:3" --local label --out "$P" -- "$T"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_proof.py "$P" --expect-valid; rm -rf "$D"

cases.name: ladder-validator-rejects-out-of-order-receipt
cases.description: A deliberately invalid debugger helper output (a ladder receipt that jumps to a breakpoint without dispatching first) must be rejected under --expect-valid, proving the gate bites on bad input instead of trusting prose.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/validate_debugger_ladder.py ladders/canonical-invalid-skips-dispatch.json --expect-valid
